name: Orbit AI - Phase 3 - Rep lookup by email (new, supports the Dialer UI)

nodes.name: Rep lookup webhook
nodes.notes: New this pass, built to support the Dialer UI (command-center's /dialer page) - it knows the viewer's Cloudflare-Access-verified email but not their Twenty CRM Rep ID/sipExtension, and Command Center never talks to Twenty CRM directly (n8n is the sole integration point, same architecture Tag-for-Action already follows). Input: {email}.

nodes.name: Fetch Rep by email
nodes.notes: REST-shape uncertainty flagged more prominently than usual here, per CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's own Rep section: 'genuinely uncertain which endpoint Twenty CRM's native user/member object lives at (/rest/workspaceMembers vs /rest/users vs something else)... confirm against a real instance before building the actual hopper-claim workflow's user-facing side.' This IS that user-facing side - /rest/workspaceMembers is this workflow's best guess, the single most likely thing in it to need correcting once a real Twenty CRM instance exists.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, reason: 'No Rep/Workspace Member found for this email - an admin needs to set sipExtension on this user in Twenty CRM before they can use the dialer.' }) }}
